speaker: Old Kings' Cairn
description: An Old Kings' cairn at the Stair's head (plan M6-M9 §5.4, decision 33): reading it once gives one attribute point (once-flag reward.cairn.stair_top).

nodes.text: A cairn at the head of the Giant's Stair, beside the stone king. 'Only the tall climb. Only the climbed see.'

choices.text: [Lay a hand on the stones] (+1 attribute point)

nodes.text: An Old Kings' cairn. Its strength is already in you.
